answer: Work waits on the falcon until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the ridge of the next round. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, published publicly on failure, no identity may audit its own recruit. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. Reaching the hollow of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys.
